heading.en: Chief of staff in the civil war

body.zh-Hant: 據芬蘭作者艾娃—卡伊薩·阿赫蒂艾寧（Eeva-Kaisa Ahtiainen）的傳記介紹（Otava出版），沃德瑪·赫格倫德是1893至1963年在世的軍官。芬蘭內戰（自由戰爭）期間，他擔任卡累利阿方面的參謀長；NE百科亦載他在內戰中曾是卡累利阿前線的參謀長。這是他在來源中可確認的最早軍職。
body.en: Per the publisher description of Eeva-Kaisa Ahtiainen's biography (Otava), Woldemar Hägglund lived 1893–1963. In the Finnish civil war (the "war of liberation") he served as chief of staff on the Karelian side; NE likewise records him as chief of staff on the Karelian front during the civil war. This is his earliest post attested in the sources.

citations.quote: Jääkärikenraaliluutnantti Woldemar Hägglund (1893-1963)
Hägglund toimi vapaussodassa Karjalan armeijan esikuntapäällikkönä
H. var under finska inbördeskriget bl.a. stabschef vid den karelska fronten
Hägglund, Woldemar, 1893–1963

heading.en: Winter War and the IV Army Corps

body.zh-Hant: 來源稱他在1920年代轉任國防部的常任秘書長（kansliapäällikkö）。冬季戰爭中，他指揮拉多加—卡累利阿地區的第4軍團（IV Armeijakunta／4:e armékåren），並在拉多加以北的多次反擊中擊敗蘇軍。其中以科拉（Kollaa）一帶的防禦最有名：傳說他問「科拉守得住嗎？」，得到肯定的答覆，這場戰役使他被稱為「莫提將軍」。
body.en: The publisher description says that in the 1920s he moved to the Ministry of Defence as permanent secretary (kansliapäällikkö). In the Winter War he commanded the IV Army Corps (IV Armeijakunta / 4:e armékåren) in Ladoga Karelia and, per NE, defeated Soviet forces in several counter-attacks north of Ladoga. The best known is the Kollaa defence, tied to the question "Will Kollaa hold?" and its legendary answer; the battle earned him the nickname of the "motti general".

citations.quote: 1920-luvulla hän siirtyi puolustusministeriön kansliapäälliköksi
Talvisodassa hän komensi Laatokan-Karjalassa IV Armeijakuntaa
Under vinterkriget förde han befälet över 4:e armékåren
besegra de sovjetiska styrkorna vid ett flertal mottistrider norr om Ladoga
sai kysymykseensä "Kestääkö Kollaa?" legendaarisen vastauksen
mottikenraaliksi ristitty

body.zh-Hant: 據NE，赫格倫德1942年晉升中將（generallöjtnant）。繼續戰爭期間，他先任軍團長（armékårchef），之後改任負責築城規劃的參謀長（stabschef för befästningsplanläggningen），1945年退役。Otava的介紹補充說，他在曼納海姆的總司令部被視為有才華的戰略與戰術家。冬季戰爭與繼續戰爭的確切起迄日期，兩份來源都沒寫，已列為缺漏。
body.en: According to NE, Hägglund became a lieutenant general (generallöjtnant) in 1942. In the Continuation War he was first an army corps commander (armékårchef) and then chief of staff for fortification planning (stabschef för befästningsplanläggningen), and he retired in 1945. The Otava description adds that in Mannerheim's headquarters he was regarded as a gifted strategist and tactician. Exact start and end dates of his commands are not given in either source and are recorded as gaps.

citations.quote: generallöjtnant 1942
Under fortsättningskriget var han först armékårchef
därefter stabschef för befästningsplanläggningen
Han tog avsked 1945
Mannerheimin Päämajassa Hägglund tunnettiin lahjakkaana strategistina

heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 據《加拿大傳記辭典》（DCB），哈利·克里勒1888年4月28日生於安大略省漢密爾頓。1914年8月對德宣戰時他志願加入加拿大遠征軍，1918年6月21日到加拿大軍團司令部，成為負責砲兵的關鍵參謀。他1923年1月起在英國參謀學院（坎伯利）修兩年課程，1933至1934年又獲推薦入帝國國防學院。
body.en: According to the Dictionary of Canadian Biography (DCB), Henry Crerar was born on 28 April 1888 in Hamilton, Ontario. When war was declared on Germany in August 1914 he volunteered for the Canadian Expeditionary Force, and on 21 June 1918 he arrived at Canadian Corps headquarters as the key artillery staff officer. He began the two-year course at the British Staff College in January 1923 and attended the Imperial Defence College in 1933–34.

citations.quote: b. 28 April 1888 in Hamilton, Ont.
When war was declared against Germany in August 1914
where he arrived on 21 June 1918
began the two-year course in January 1923
to attend Britain’s Imperial Defence College in 1933–34

heading.zh-Hant: 皇家軍事學院與渥太華總參謀部
heading.en: Royal Military College and Ottawa general staff

body.zh-Hant: DCB載，克里勒1938年8月出任皇家軍事學院院長；1939年10月他以總參謀部准將身分赴英，後成為加拿大軍事總部的資深戰鬥軍官。官方戰史稱他在倫敦九個月後被調回渥太華，出任陸軍總參謀長（CGS）；DCB記為1940年7月先任副總參謀長，當月總參謀長退休，使他成為陸軍規劃與指揮機構的首長，並將總參謀長一職鞏固為政府的首席軍事顧問。官方戰史又說，他1941年12月返英原要指揮第2師，卻因麥克諾頓長期患病，立即代理加拿大軍團指揮。
body.en: DCB records that Crerar became commandant of the Royal Military College in August 1938; in October 1939 he was sent to England as brigadier, general staff, and later became the senior combatant officer at Canadian Military Headquarters. The official history says that after nine months in London he was brought back to Ottawa as Chief of the General Staff (CGS); the DCB gives July 1940 as vice-CGS, with the CGS retiring that month, leaving him at the head of the army’s planning and directing body and consolidating the CGS post as the government’s chief military adviser. The official history adds that he returned to the United Kingdom in December 1941 to command the 2nd Division but, because of McNaughton’s extended illness, immediately assumed acting command of the Canadian Corps.

citations.quote: Crerar was appointed commandant of the Royal Military College in August 1938
he was sent to England in October as brigadier, general staff
he was made senior combatant officer at the Canadian Military Headquarters
After nine months in London Crerar was now brought back to Ottawa
he became Chief of the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: DCB載，克里勒1941年12月23日晉升中將並代理第1加拿大軍軍長，1942年4月6日被正式任命為軍長，任至1944年3月19日。DCB稱他在軍長任內使效率穩步提升，並支持小規模突襲，1942年8月19日的迪耶普突襲即其一例；1944年5月他對金恩說，諾曼第登陸計畫大半以迪耶普的經驗為基礎。
body.en: The DCB records that on 23 December 1941 Crerar was promoted lieutenant-general and became acting commander of the 1st Canadian Corps, and on 6 April 1942 was named general officer commanding the corps, a post he held until 19 March 1944. The DCB says his tenure brought a steady improvement in efficiency and that he supported small-scale raids such as the Dieppe raid of 19 August 1942; in May 1944 he told King that the Normandy plan was largely based on experience derived from Dieppe.

heading.zh-Hant: 第1加拿大集團軍：諾曼第至須耳德河
heading.en: First Canadian Army: Normandy to the Scheldt

body.zh-Hant: 官方戰史的任職表載，克里勒自1944年3月20日起任第1加拿大集團軍總司令。DCB稱，該集團軍隸屬蒙哥馬利的第21集團軍群，直到1944年7月23日才作為統一部隊投入作戰。9月初他決定出席迪耶普的紀念儀式，與蒙哥馬利發生激烈衝突；9月底他疲憊不堪，26日赴英療養，西蒙德斯接掌集團軍並負責奪取須耳德河口。
body.en: The official history’s table of appointments lists Crerar as General Officer Commanding-in-Chief of First Canadian Army from 20 March 1944. The DCB says the army was part of Montgomery’s 21st Army Group and became operational as a unified force only on 23 July 1944. In early September his decision to attend a memorial service at Dieppe led to a stormy clash with Montgomery; by the end of September he was exhausted and left for treatment in England on the 26th, and Simonds took over the army and assumed responsibility for capturing the Scheldt.

body.zh-Hant: DCB載，克里勒恢復指揮後把精力集中於萊茵蘭戰役，「真實行動」（Operation Veritable）的構想在很大程度上出自他，他最終麾下有13個師，其中9個為英軍。1945年3月初萊茵蘭之戰進入尾聲。他1945年4月21日赴倫敦，由西蒙德斯代理集團軍司令至29日返回。官方戰史載，他任集團軍總司令至1945年7月30日。DCB記他1946年退役。
body.en: The DCB says that after resuming command Crerar concentrated on clearing the Rhineland; Operation Veritable was as much his as anyone’s, and he eventually had 13 divisions under him, 9 of them British. By early March 1945 the Rhineland struggle was in its final stages. He went to London on 21 April 1945, leaving Simonds as acting army commander until his return on the 29th. The official history gives 30 July 1945 as the end of his command of the army, and the DCB records that he retired in 1946.

body.zh-Hant: 據朱諾海灘中心，安德魯·麥克諾頓1887年2月25日生於莫斯明（今薩斯喀徹溫）。他在麥基爾大學取得物理與工程學位（1910年學士、1912年碩士），1909年加入民兵，1914年加入加拿大遠征軍第4砲兵連。
body.en: According to the Juno Beach Centre, Andrew McNaughton was born at Moosomin (now Saskatchewan) on 25 February 1887. He graduated in physics and engineering from McGill University (B.S. 1910, M.S. 1912), enlisted in the Militia in 1909 and in 1914 joined the 4th Battery of the Canadian Expeditionary Corps.

citations.quote: Moosomin (then North-West Territories, now in Saskatchewan) February 25, 1887
He enlists in the Militia in 1909
then in 1914, in the 4th Battery of the Canadian Expeditionary Corps

heading.zh-Hant: 總參謀長與國家研究委員會
heading.en: Chief of the General Staff and the National Research Council

body.zh-Hant: 加拿大戰爭博物館載，麥克諾頓1929至1935年任總參謀長（Chief of the General Staff），1935至1939年任國家研究委員會主席。朱諾海灘中心說，他任總參謀長期間推動軍隊機械化與民兵現代化。
body.en: The Canadian War Museum records McNaughton as Chief of the General Staff from 1929 to 1935 and president of the National Research Council from 1935 to 1939. The Juno Beach Centre adds that he worked at mechanizing the armed forces and modernizing the Militia.

citations.quote: He was Chief of the General Staff from 1929 to 1935
president of the National Research Council from 1935 to 1939
He works at mechanizing the armed forces and modernizing the Militia

body.zh-Hant: 朱諾海灘中心載，二戰爆發時他成為加拿大第1步兵師師長，該部1940年擴編為軍、1942年再擴編為集團軍；他1939至1940年任第1步兵師師長，1940至1942年任第1加拿大軍軍長，1942至1943年任第1加拿大集團軍司令。他因批准迪耶普戰役（原文稱 operation against Dieppe）而遭批評，又因堅持不拆散在英國的加拿大部隊與英方和政府失和，1943年12月在壓力與健康問題下辭去指揮職。
body.en: The Juno Beach Centre records that on the outbreak of war he commanded the First Canadian Infantry Division, which grew into a corps (1940) and then an army (1942); he was GOC of the division in 1939–40, of the First Canadian Corps in 1940–42 and General Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the First Canadian Army in 1942–43. He was criticized for approving the Dieppe operation, and his opposition to splitting up Canadian troops in Britain antagonized the British staff and his own government. He resigned his command in December 1943 under pressure and ill health.

First Canadian Corps from 1940 to 1942
General Officer Commanding-in-Chief First Canadian Army from 1942 to 1943
especially his approval of the ill-fated operation against Dieppe
antagonized both the British senior Staff and the Canadian government

heading.en: Minister of Defence and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 朱諾海灘中心說，首相金（King）1944年任命他為國防部長，任務是解決徵兵問題，但他未能解決，也沒能獲選進入下議院，任期至1945年。戰後他代表加拿大出席聯合國原子能委員會，1946至1948年主持加拿大原子能管制委員會，1948至1949年任常駐聯合國代表，1950至1959年任國際聯合委員會加拿大分部主席。
body.en: The Juno Beach Centre says he was appointed Minister of Defence in 1944 with the specific mandate of solving the conscription issue; he could not, and Canadians denied him the support to be elected to the House of Commons. His term ran to 1945. After the war he was Canada's representative to the UN Atomic Energy Commission, chaired the Canadian Atomic Energy Control Commission in 1946–48, was Permanent Representative to the UN in 1948–49 and, in 1950–59, president of the Canadian section of the International Joint Commission.

body.zh-Hant: 據朱諾海灘中心，蓋伊·西蒙德斯1903年4月23日生於英格蘭，1921至1925年就讀皇家軍事學院，1936至1938年在英國坎伯利參謀學院深造。1939年戰爭爆發後他任第1步兵師二級參謀，1941年5月任第2步兵師一級參謀，1942年9月出任第1步兵旅旅長。據皇家加拿大砲兵協會（RCA），他1925年畢業後受任皇家加拿大騎砲兵（RCHA），1940年曾有三個月指揮第1野戰團。
body.en: According to the Juno Beach Centre, Guy Simonds was born in England on 23 April 1903, studied at the Royal Military College in 1921–25 and at the Staff College in Camberley in 1936–38. After the outbreak of war he was GSO2 of the 1st Infantry Division; he became GSO1 of the 2nd Infantry Division in May 1941 and commander of the 1st Infantry Brigade in September 1942. According to the Royal Canadian Artillery Association (RCA), after graduating in 1925 he was commissioned in the Royal Canadian Horse Artillery (RCHA), and in 1940 he commanded the 1st Field Regiment for three months.

body.zh-Hant: 朱諾海灘中心載，西蒙德斯1943年4月出任加拿大第1步兵師師長，已是少將；他在西西里島登陸戰中指揮該師，經尼索里亞（Nissoria）、阿吉拉（Agira）、雷加爾布托（Regalbuto）等戰鬥，受蒙哥馬利注意。1943年11月1日至1944年1月29日，他轉任加拿大第5裝甲師師長。RCA則稱，他1943年春先受命指揮第2加拿大師，兩週後晉升，隨即接掌備戰西西里的第1加拿大師。
body.en: The Juno Beach Centre records that Simonds commanded the 1st Canadian Infantry Division from April 1943 as a major-general. He led it in the invasion of Sicily through the battles of Nissoria, Agira and Regalbuto and was noticed by Montgomery. From 1 November 1943 to 29 January 1944 he headed the 5th Canadian Armoured Division. The RCA adds that in spring 1943 he was first appointed to command the 2nd Canadian Division and, two weeks later, promoted and given the 1st Canadian Division preparing for Sicily.

body.zh-Hant: 朱諾海灘中心載，西蒙德斯1944年1月晉升中將並任第2加拿大軍軍長，7月該軍司令部移駐法國。7、8月間他指揮「大西洋」「春季」「全面」「可處理」四項行動；其中「全面」行動（Totalize）在8月7日，「可處理」行動（Tractable）在8月14日，使加拿大與波蘭部隊得以封閉法萊斯缺口。
body.en: The Juno Beach Centre records that in January 1944 Simonds was promoted to Lieutenant-General and GOC of II Canadian Corps, whose headquarters moved to France in July 1944. In July and August he headed four operations: Atlantic, Spring, Totalize and Tractable. Totalize took place on 7 August and Tractable on 14 August, allowing Canadian and Polish troops to close the Falaise Gap.

heading.en: Acting army command and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 朱諾海灘中心說，1944年9月27日西蒙德斯暫代克里勒指揮第1加拿大集團軍，在謝爾德河口的作戰中展現戰術才能；RMC的紀錄稱此代理從9月到11月，之後他回任第2軍軍長。戰後他先任帝國國防學院首席教官，1951至1955年任總參謀長（CGS），為朝鮮戰爭與北約任務整編加拿大陸軍。
body.en: The Juno Beach Centre says that on 27 September 1944 Simonds took charge of the 1st Canadian Army on a temporary basis in place of Crerar and showed tactical skill in the clearance of the Scheldt estuary; RMC dates the acting command to September–November 1944, after which he resumed command of II Canadian Corps. After the war he went to the Imperial Defence College and in 1951–55 was Chief of the General Staff, reorganizing the army for the Korean War and NATO.

heading.en: The end of the war in 1945

body.zh-Hant: 官方戰史載，1945年4月22日弗里西亞群島的作戰任務交給第2加拿大軍軍長西蒙德斯，他同日再度出任集團軍代理司令；克里勒29日返回司令部，5月5日停戰使該行動無須進行。官方戰史任職表載，西蒙德斯擔任第2加拿大軍軍長自1944年1月30日至1945年6月25日。RCA稱戰事結束時他指揮駐荷蘭的加拿大部隊與駐西北德國的加拿大占領軍。
body.en: The official history says that on 22 April 1945 responsibility for reducing the Frisian Islands was delegated to Simonds, GOC 2nd Canadian Corps, who the same day again became acting army commander; Crerar returned to his headquarters on 29 April, and the end of hostilities on 5 May removed the need for the operation. The official history’s table of appointments lists Simonds as GOC 2nd Canadian Corps from 30 January 1944 to 25 June 1945. The RCA says that at the end of hostilities he commanded the Canadian forces in the Netherlands and the Canadian Army of Occupation in north-west Germany.

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館（AWM），哈里·肖韋爾1865年4月16日生於新南威爾斯的塔布蘭。波耳戰爭時他是昆士蘭常備軍上尉，在南非指揮昆士蘭騎兵步兵A中隊，返澳後接掌第7聯邦輕騎兵團。1914年7月，他以上校身分出任澳洲駐倫敦帝國總參謀部的代表。美國國會圖書館名稱權威檔列其為「Chauvel, Henry George, Sir, 1865-1945」。
body.en: According to the Australian War Memorial (AWM), Harry Chauvel was born in Tabulam, New South Wales, on 16 April 1865. By the Boer War he was a captain in the Queensland permanent forces and commanded A Squadron of the Queensland Mounted Infantry in South Africa, then returned to Australia to command the 7th Commonwealth Light Horse. In July 1914, as a full colonel, he became Australia's representative on the Imperial General Staff in London. The Library of Congress name authority lists him as “Chauvel, Henry George, Sir, 1865-1945”.

body.zh-Hant: AWM載，肖韋爾以第1輕騎兵旅旅長身分參加加里波利戰役，1915年5月12日抵達後接掌包括奎因哨所在內的防區，後因病後送。1915年9月他回任新西蘭與澳洲師師長，11月出任第1澳洲師師長並晉升少將；1916年6月成為駐埃及澳洲帝國軍總司令。他在羅馬尼擊敗土耳其軍，阻止其再度逼近蘇伊士。
body.en: The AWM records that Chauvel served on Gallipoli as commander of the 1st Light Horse Brigade, arriving on 12 May to take command of a sector that included Quinn's Post; illness forced his evacuation. He returned in September 1915 to command the New Zealand and Australian Division, took command of the 1st Australian Division in November and was promoted major general; in June 1916 he became General Officer Commanding, AIF in Egypt. He defeated the Turks at Romani, stopping their second attempt to reach the Suez.

heading.zh-Hant: 沙漠騎兵軍與貝爾謝巴

body.zh-Hant: 1917年8月，肖韋爾成為首位常設指揮軍級單位的澳洲人，統率由英、澳、紐部隊組成的沙漠騎兵軍；這在兩次進攻加薩失敗之後。第三次進攻需奪取貝爾謝巴，由第4輕騎旅的著名騎馬衝鋒達成，打開了進軍巴勒斯坦之路，土耳其於1918年10月投降。
body.en: In August 1917 Chauvel became the first Australian to permanently command, the Desert Mounted Corps of British, Australian and New Zealand units, after two failed attempts to take Gaza. The third attempt required the capture of Beersheba, achieved through the famous mounted charge of the 4th Light Horse Brigade; this opened the way for the advance through Palestine, which ended with the Turkish surrender in October 1918.

body.zh-Hant: AWM載，肖韋爾1919年底返回澳洲，出任陸軍最高職位的監察總長（Inspector General），任至1930年；1929年11月晉升上將，是首位達此軍階的澳洲人，1930年4月退役。二戰期間他出任義勇防衛軍監察總長，直到1945年3月4日逝世。
body.en: The AWM records that Chauvel returned to Australia in late 1919 and was appointed Inspector General, the Army's most senior post, which he kept until 1930. In November 1929 he was promoted to general, the first Australian to reach that rank, and he retired in April 1930. In the Second World War he was Inspector General of the Volunteer Defence Corps until his death on 4 March 1945.

body.zh-Hant: AWM《五十位澳洲人》載，1916年起肖韋爾的騎兵團追擊土耳其軍穿越西奈；1917年中東部隊重組後，他獲任沙漠騎兵軍軍長，成為澳洲軍階最高的軍人。他的輕騎部隊攻佔耶路撒冷，並於1918年10月1日進入大馬士革。
body.en: The AWM’s Fifty Australians page says that from 1916 Chauvel’s regiments pursued the Turks through Sinai; in the 1917 reorganisation of the forces in the Middle East he was given command of the Desert Mounted Corps, becoming Australia’s highest-ranked soldier. His light horsemen captured Jerusalem and, on 1 October 1918, entered Damascus.

heading.en: Chief of the General Staff, later years and death

body.zh-Hant: AWM載，肖韋爾1923年起任總參謀長；1929年晉升上將，是首位達此軍階的澳洲本土現役軍官，隔年退役。二戰時他七十五歲再度穿上軍服，出任義勇防衛軍的總監察。他於1945年3月4日逝世，在墨爾本聖保羅座堂舉行國葬儀式。
body.en: The AWM says that from 1923 Chauvel was chief of the general staff; in 1929 he was promoted general, the first local serving officer to reach that rank, and he retired the following year. In the Second World War, aged 75, he returned to uniform as inspector-in-chief of the Volunteer Defence Corps. He died on 4 March 1945 and was given a state funeral service at St Paul’s Cathedral, Melbourne.
